roleContext.roleTitle: Customer Success Manager, Analytics Software Accounts
roleContext.jobDescription: The analytics software company's customer success team looks after the mid-market accounts that use its products. The Customer Success Manager runs the quarterly business reviews with each account, tracks adoption against the success plan, coordinates renewals with the account executive, handles escalations from the accounts with the support team, and documents each account's open items. Renewal pricing decisions stay with the account executive. The role requires presenting to customer executives with authority. Reports to the head of customer success; works with the account executives, the support team and the product managers.

requirements.text: Runs quarterly business reviews with each account under the team's review format.
Presents adoption findings and recommendations to customer executives in the business reviews.
Tracks adoption against each account's success plan in the customer success platform.
Coordinates renewals with the account executive, with pricing decisions staying with the account executive, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents each account's open items and hand-over conditions.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Customer Success Manager, Analytics Software Accounts

## Experience

- Customer success manager at an analytics software company for three years, running the quarterly business reviews for a book of twenty-two mid-market accounts under the team's review format.
- Presented the adoption findings and recommendations to the accounts' executives in each review; the review records carry the attendees and the actions agreed, and the customer executives' post-review survey scored the presentations at or above the team average in every quarter.
- Tracked adoption against each account's success plan in the customer success platform, with the plans reviewed monthly with the head of customer success.
- Coordinated renewals with the account executives through the renewal tracker; the pricing decisions were the account executives', and the tracker records which preparation was mine.
- Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions for each account at each quarter end.

## Work samples

- Work sample: two quarterly business review records with attendees, actions and survey scores, one success plan and the renewal tracker extract for one quarter, with the customer success platform references as a verification trail.
